label: DRT2 system
definition: A DRT system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DRT_2 subtype locus represented by the DRT_2__drt2 profile.
observations: DRT2 branch under DRT system; distinct from the broader DRT system, the individual DRT2 reverse-transcriptase profile row, unresolved DRT2 phage triggers, direct RT products, host breadth, partner features, and other DRT subtypes.
